run_DiT_training: run the DiT training script with a data path and optional model, image size, and batch size arguments
run_training_with_custom_model: run the DiT training script using a custom model like DiT-XL/2 on a specified dataset path
run_training_with_checkpoints: run the DiT training script and save checkpoints every 50000 steps to the results directory
review_main_training_loop: review the main training loop that handles DDP setup, VAE encoding, diffusion losses, and EMA updates
review_update_ema: review the update_ema function that steps the EMA model weights toward the current model with configurable decay
